Chapter 283 Gu Refining Prodigy

However, Ye Yan is known as the Yan Emperor, and the power of the immortal fire he possesses is naturally not worthy of.

At this moment, Ao Qing kept spitting out dragon breath from his mouth.

The void had already boiled under the attacks of the two.

But at this moment, everyone forgot one thing.

Aoqing is the Ice Dragon Clan. Aoqing is better at freezing except for the dragon breath that every dragon clan can teach.

In the distance, Ye Yan's forehead began to be covered with fine cold sweat.

Looking at Ao Qing in the distance, Ye Yan's face looked a little ugly.

Because he felt that Ao Qing didn't use his full strength at all.

Once upon a time, I would have been underestimated.

"Nine-Clawed Dragon, take out your full strength, otherwise, don't blame me!"

Ye Yan roared in a low voice.

The sound is extremely heavy.

Hearing this, everyone was already shocked.

Ao Qing is actually hiding his strength.

Ao Qing stopped and looked at Ye Yan in the distance with interest.

At this moment, he also had a little recognition of the evil list.

Although being called a monster may be a bit exaggerated, it is still a bit powerful.

"That's what you said."

For a moment, Ao Qing's aura suddenly began to change drastically.

The hot space temperature suddenly began to drop sharply.

Scream!

A cold air overflowed through Long Lin Zi Zi's body.

At this moment, everyone suddenly realized that Ao Qing was an ice dragon!

"Binglin!"

boom!

An ice-blue dot of light flew out of Ao Qing's mouth. In an instant, everyone seemed to be in the ice age.

Everyone shivered and looked at the void in horror.

Ye Yan looked at the light spot flying towards him, with shock in his eyes.

The next moment, Ye Yan's flames burned rapidly, almost infinitely close to purple.

boom!

Ye Yan punched out with a sudden punch.

After a while, the light dissipated. Ye Yan half-kneeled in the void. His right hand had completely frozen, and his body was covered with frost.

Ye Yan, lost.

Until the end, Ye Yan did not choose to recover.

In another void, Li Changqing looked at Ye Yan with a hint of complexity in his eyes.

At the same level, my proud disciple would lose so badly.

Although I had guessed the ending a long time ago, I didn't expect the process to be like this.

"Nine-clawed Dragon, I am really the most powerful monster in the world."

"If he reaches the Immortal Emperor Realm, he may be able to directly rush into the top twenty of the demon list."

"The top twenty? I'm afraid it's more than that."

At this moment, the people in the academy looked extremely complicated.

Looking at Ye Yan, who was inexplicably desolate, everyone lowered their heads.

"Ah hahahaha, I'm so laughing to death. Ye Yan, I haven't seen you for many years, why are you so tired?"

A dazzling light flashed by.

Everyone looked in the sound and saw a bald man looking up at Ye Yan, smiling from ear to ear.

"Who are you? How dare you do this,"

A student in the academy was about to angrily scold him when he was suddenly covered by the person around him.

"Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhh, do you know who he is!"

Obviously, the bald man has an extraordinary identity.

In the void, Ye Yan also looked down. When he saw the bald man, Ye Yan's face turned even more ugly.

"It's you bald ass!"

"Fuck, Ye Gou, you are looking for death!"

As soon as the two met, they started to squirt each other.

Ao Qing looked at the two of them and said nothing, but flew to the front of the martial arts list lightly.

In this battle, he did not show much strength. After all, Ye Yan suppressed his own realm. If he still needed to use all his strength in this way, he might as well just ask his master to reincarnate.

The nine-clawed dragon is not blown out.

At this moment, Ao Qing didn't know that his identity had begun to spread rapidly, causing considerable uproar in the fairy world.

Countless demon clans couldn't help but feel excited, as if they had already seen the once glorious demon court reappearing in the world.

The demon clan is about to rise!

But there are also some demons who have ulterior motives. If they swallow the Nine-Clawed Dragon, they will definitely greatly improve their talent.

Faced with all this, Ao Qing didn't notice anything.

Of course, even if he noticed it, he would not feel panic at all.

Eat and drink when you need to. Don’t put it in your heart if you have something to do.

Not long after, everyone finally knew the identity of the bald man.

The 26th place in the monster list, Dongku.

One more than Ye Yan.

But it seems that Ye Yan doesn't think he is convinced.

A moment later, Dongku came to Ao Qing and looked at Ao Qing a few times.

"What, you want to be beaten?"

Hearing this, Dongku laughed and said, "Let's talk about it when you reach the Immortal Emperor Realm."

Facing Ao Qing, Dongku did not choose to compete, and he had already seen Ao Qing's strength.

He really wasn't sure if he wanted to fight at the same level.

That said, it's just a matter of saving face.

Hearing this, Ao Qing didn't say anything else and continued to stare at the martial arts list.

At this moment, Lu Xue had already reached the top twenty of the martial arts list.

When you get to this term, you basically meet strong people from the Immortal Saint Realm.

With the peak strength of Lu Xue's Immortal Lord Realm, to be honest, there is no pressure at all when facing these powerful immortal holy realms.

If Lu Xue cannot defeat her opponent in this way, then she will be really sorry for Lu Daosheng.

What Lu Xueque now is just combat experience.

"It seems that Sister Xue is going to make a big move and go directly to the top ten."

“More than the top ten.”

Xiao Luo and the others walked to Ao Qing and murmured at the martial arts list.

At the same time, several college students on the list of evil spirits returned to the academy.

When they learned that Ye Yan had lost to Ao Qing in the same level, they were all shocked.

They knew Ye Yan's strength very well.

Although not as good as them, there are definitely not many people who are worse.

On the Monster List, the ones who can really open up the gap are the top ones in the Monster List.

The higher you are, the bigger the gap in strength.

Of course, Ao Qing's strength shocked them, but what shocked them even more was that Ao Qing was actually the fairy pet of a student in their academy.

Use the Nine-Clawed Dragon as the Immortal Pet.

That must be so capable.

For a moment, the existence of several monsters was also very curious about Lu Xue.

......

On the other side, inside Zhuyun Peak.

"Little girl, didn't your master tell you anything before leaving?"

In a courtyard with a strong medicinal aroma, Jordan Yang was like a follower, chatting behind Yuanyuan.

The round and dark eyebrows were furrowed.

As if he was annoyed by the question, Yuanyuan said, "My master said that I would follow Sister Xue."

"None?"

Jordan Yang couldn't believe it.

"It's gone."

Round and expressionless face.

After a moment of silence, Jordan Yang coughed lightly and said, "Well, little girl, although I am not as good as your master, I am also one of the best alchemists in the fairy world. Why not, let us discuss the truth?"

Discuss the Tao?

Hearing this, Yuanyuan glared at Jordanyang directly and shouted, "Get out!"

He put two green onions on his nose and really treated himself as an elephant.

With just your alchemy skills, let alone your master, she doesn't even look down on her.

What I pursued was like her master Shi Liantian, becoming a genius of Gu refining!
